item.text: {"question_id":"8B.2","answer":"During 2023, Scholz’s federal government translated several priorities into enacted legal and institutional machinery, including the Bürgergeld Act, Wohngeld-Plus, care reform, Supply Chain Act, smart-meter law, electoral reform, competition-law amendment, whistleblower protections, police-check documentation, and municipal heat-planning law (BATCH-0026-E007; BATCH-0024-E008; BATCH-0027-E014; BATCH-0008-E009; BATCH-0009-E003; BATCH-0026-E006; BATCH-0007-E007; BATCH-0001-E022; BATCH-0008-E003; BATCH-0009-E010). The National Security Strategy and the €100 billion Bundeswehr special fund supplied additional strategic and budgetary machinery, although the evidence does not establish adequate disbursement, procurement, readiness, or implementation (BATCH-0014-E007; BATCH-0016-E006). Operationalization was uneven: the China strategy lacked binding targets and concrete dependency-reduction measures (BATCH-0007-E009); the National Security Council was not created (BATCH-0005-E012); and digital-administration, data-strategy, heat-planning, hospital-reform, and bureaucracy-reduction initiatives included proposals, roadmaps, projected relief, or future deadlines rather than completed 2023 execution (BATCH-0009-E011; BATCH-0028-E007; BATCH-0025-E019; BATCH-0030-E011; BATCH-0009-E008). The skilled-immigration amendment entered into force in stages, but the supplied record does not establish its complete enactment or implementation quality (BATCH-0006-E002). Independent audit and expert evidence identified delayed projects, hesitant implementation, insufficient targeting and staffing, inadequate defense funding, and missing digital standards, timelines, cost clarity, and monitoring (BATCH-0003-E009; BATCH-0003-E011; BATCH-0003-E012; BATCH-0009-E012). Overall, the record supports substantial but incomplete formal operationalization; it does not establish enforcement, compliance, outcomes, or Scholz’s individual drafting, appointment, allocation, or corrective decisions, and responsibility is shared with ministers, Parliament, agencies, Länder, and inherited
